document.description: Exercises the XML tokenizer's CDATA handling: everything inside the CDATA section must stay literal even though it looks like markup.
document.payload: <not-a-real-tag attr="value"> This looks like XML but it is literal character data. A lone close-bracket pair is fine; only bracket-bracket-greater-than closes the section, so that exact sequence is avoided here. </not-a-real-tag>
document.afterward: This element should highlight normally again.
